topics.topic: Resume behavior after standing grant revocation for elements waiting `service_unreachable`
questions: For an element currently waiting `service_unreachable` after a send authorized by a standing grant that is later revoked, should resume resend immediately, or must the element first transition to `owner_approval` and wait for explicit approval?

If an element is waiting on `service_unreachable` from a prior send under a standing grant, and that grant is revoked before resume, does resume still send it immediately, or convert it to `owner_approval` and not send?

topics.topic: Canonical encoding/shape and validation rules for continuation tokens
questions: What is the token’s concrete encoding/shape and validation rule, so different implementations produce/accept the same token?

topics.topic: Disclosure class assignment for mapped-node outputs when mapped input is empty
questions: What disclosure_class must be assigned to each output value of a mapped node that runs over an empty list, so downstream disclosure checks and surface responses are deterministic?

topics.topic: Header-name matching semantics (case sensitivity) and duplicate required-header handling
questions: Is header-name comparison case-sensitive or case-insensitive (HTTP header names are case-insensitive), and how are duplicate required headers handled?

topics.topic: How to handle malformed `idempotency_key` text for `read` operation binding proposal/acceptance
questions: When proposing/accepting a binding for a `read` operation, must malformed `idempotency_key` text be refused, or ignored entirely?

topics.topic: Ordering between approval creation/wait and pre-send unsendable checks for effectful operations
questions: When an effectful node is unsendable before send (for example stale binding or unplaceable input) and no approval exists yet, does the kernel first create/wait on approval, or fail immediately with `operation_failed` without creating an approval request?

topics.topic: Refusal classification/order for file-output constraint failures during binding proposal
questions: When this file-output constraint fails at proposal time, is the refusal classified as `manifest mismatch` (and where in A08 order), or as a separate proposal-validation refusal?

topics.topic: Required status/detail and EffectAttempt recording when service credential resolution fails at send time
questions: If credential resolution fails while building a request, what exact node status/detail must be recorded, and is an EffectAttempt written for non-read operations?

topics.topic: Runtime behavior when token reload detects changed but invalid token configuration
questions: When live token reload detects changed configuration but the new token section is invalid, does the kernel keep old tokens, refuse all requests, or stop?

topics.topic: Whether a mapped node continues later elements in the same advance step after one element fails
questions: If one element fails (not waits), must the node continue executing later elements in that same advance step, or stop immediately?

topics.topic: Whether file input ports are allowed in `idempotency_key_fields` and their hashed value representation
questions: Are file ports allowed in `idempotency_key_fields`, and if yes, what exact value representation is hashed for the EffectAttempt idempotency key?

topics.topic: Whether structurally invalid flow definitions are persisted as failed-proof FlowVersions or rejected with no persisted version
questions: For structurally invalid flow definitions (duplicate node ids or duplicate flow port names), must the kernel keep a FlowVersion with a failed proof result, or refuse composition and keep nothing?

topics.topic: Which exact byte representation is used to enforce the request size ceiling
questions: What exact byte representation is measured for request size (raw transport bytes, decoded JSON bytes, canonical re-encoding, or MCP frame payload)?

topics.topic: `service_id` constraints needed to prevent unsafe manifest record path construction
questions: What constraints on `service_id` prevent path traversal or filesystem metacharacter interpretation when building this path?
